prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A high-resolution medical MRI scan of a human head, viewed in axial cross-section, dominates the composition. The image is rendered in shades of black, white, and muted blue, creating a clinical and scientific atmosphere. The intricate anatomical structures of the brain, skull, and facial features are clearly visible, with varying intensities of brightness highlighting different tissue densities. In the lower left corner, a smaller sagittal view of the head provides additional anatomical context. Overlaid on the image are technical details and patient information in white text, including the patient’s name, age, weight, scan parameters, and the name of the hospital, all arranged in a precise, utilitarian manner. The background is a deep black, emphasizing the luminous, almost ethereal quality of the scan itself. The overall style is documentary and highly realistic, with a focus on clarity, detail, and the stark beauty of medical imaging. The lighting is even and internal, characteristic of MRI technology, with no external shadows or highlights. The composition is centered and symmetrical, evoking a sense of order and scientific inquiry.
